title: Sales and prospecting
summary: Route a prospect-list request to the verified account-and-contact Skill or stop when the request needs a different unverified sales or RevOps outcome.
outcome: One explicit choice of the verified account-and-contact research workflow, or a clear stop when the request requires an unavailable mutation or broader GTM function.
boundary: The router does not run catalog tools, send outreach, write to a CRM, or cover positioning, marketing operations, attribution, forecasting or revenue operations.

catalog_tools.purpose: Used only after routing to Sales Qualified Accounts.

inputs: The sales-research outcome or deliverable the user wants
Any supplied ideal-customer profile, buyer role, geography or target count
outputs: One selected verified function Skill and a concise reason
A clear boundary when the request requires outreach, CRM mutation or a broader GTM function

cost.model: Routing is agent-side and makes no paid call.
cost.notes: The selected function Skill presents and obtains approval for its own paid plan.

approvals: Ask before installing or updating a missing function Skill; paid and mutation approvals belong to the selected function Skill
compatibility: The selected function Skill installed from the same pinned repository revision
